arxiv-2010-09033.title: A dual formulation of wavefield reconstruction inversion for large-scale seismic inversion
arxiv-2010-09033.creator: Gabrio Rizzuti, Mathias Louboutin, Rongrong Wang, Felix J. Herrmann
arxiv-2010-09033.description: Abstract 1 Abstract Many of the seismic inversion techniques currently proposed that focus on robustness with respect to the background model choice are not apt to large-scale 3D applications, and the methods that are computationally feasible for industrial problems, such as full waveform inversion, are notoriously bogged down by local minima and require adequate starting models.

arxiv-2202-06435.description: Abstract Radio access network (RAN) slicing is a key technology that enables 5G network to support heterogeneous requirements of generic services, namely ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) and enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB). In this paper, we propose a two time-scales RAN slicing mechanism to optimize the performance of URLLC and eMBB services.

arxiv-2401-17403.title: Ozone: Fully Out-of-Order Choreographies
arxiv-2401-17403.creator: Dan Plyukhin, Marco Peressotti, Fabrizio Montesi
arxiv-2401-17403.description: Abstract Choreographic programming is a paradigm for writing distributed applications. It allows programmers to write a single program, called a choreography, that can be compiled to generate correct implementations of each process in the application. Although choreographies provide good static guarantees, they can exhibit high latency when messages or processes are delayed.

arxiv-2402-14030.title: On the initial spin period distribution of neutron stars BILBY ( Ashton et al. 2019 ) , DYNESTY ( Speagle 2020 ) , ChainConsumer ( Hinton 2016 ; Hinton et al. 2024 ) , Scipy ( Virtanen et al. 2021 ) .
arxiv-2402-14030.creator: Shen-Shi Du, Xiao-Jin Liu, Zu-Cheng Chen, Zhi-Qiang You, Xing-Jiang Zhu, Zong-Hong Zhu
arxiv-2402-14030.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shen-Shi Du, Xiao-Jin Liu, Zu-Cheng Chen, Zhi-Qiang You, Xing-Jiang Zhu, Zong-Hong Zhu. We derive the initial spin period distribution of neutron stars by studying the population of young pulsars associated with supernova remnants. Our hierarchical Bayesian approach accounts for the measurement uncertainties of individual observations and selection effects.

arxiv-2412-05196.title: Exponential Speedups by Rerooting Levin Tree Search
arxiv-2412-05196.creator: Laurent Orseau, Marcus Hutter, Levi H. S. Lelis
arxiv-2412-05196.description: Abstract Levin Tree Search (LTS) ( Orseau et al., 2018 ) is a search algorithm for deterministic environments that uses a user-specified policy to guide the search. It comes with a formal guarantee on the number of search steps (node visits) for finding a solution node that depends on the quality of the policy.

pmc-11466821.title: Genomics 2 Proteins portal: a resource and discovery tool for linking genetic screening outputs to protein sequences and structures
pmc-11466821.creator: Seulki Kwon, Jordan Safer, Duyen T Nguyen, David Hoksza, Patrick May, Jeremy A Arbesfeld, Alan F Rubin, Arthur J Campbell, Alex Burgin, Sumaiya Iqbal
pmc-11466821.description: Recent advances in AI-based methods have revolutionized the field of structural biology. Concomitantly, high-throughput sequencing and functional genomics have generated genetic variants at an unprecedented scale. However, efficient tools and resources are needed to link disparate data types—to ‘map’ variants onto protein structures, to better understand how the variation causes disease, and thereby design therapeutics.

pmc-12426394.title: Practitioner’s perception of myasthenia gravis management recommendations in clinical practice: a cross-sectional survey study
pmc-12426394.creator: Elena Cortés-Vicente, Antonio Guerrero-Sola, Fernando Caballero-Martínez, Francisco Javier Campos-Lucas, Juan Gómez-Salgado, Diana Monge-Martín, Rodrigo Álvarez-Velasco
pmc-12426394.description: Background:Myasthenia gravis (MG) is a chronic, fluctuating disease whose unique natural history complicates designing therapeutic trials. The evidence on which many MG management recommendations are based is limited.Objective:To determine the degree of knowledge, agreement, and application of internationally recognized recommendations for managing MG in actual practice.Design:A cross-sectional survey was conducted among Spanish neurologists specializing in MG.

pmc-12859367.title: Resin infiltration and fluoride varnish for caries control in children: A systematic review
pmc-12859367.creator: Kshitija Kamlakar Bansode, Nageshnath Baliram Waghmare, Aditya Vitthal Kulkarni, Rutuja Vikram Nalwade, Pratiksha Prakash Pawar, Anusha Jayan
pmc-12859367.description: Dental caries progression in children remains a major public health concern despite widespread fluoride use. Therefore, it is of interest to compare the effectiveness of resin infiltration combined with fluoride varnish versus fluoride varnish alone in reducing caries progression among school children. The combination therapy showed greater efficacy in arresting and reducing carious lesion progression than fluoride varnish alone.

pmc-13250868.title: Oro-esophageal feeding for tracheostomized patients with severe traumatic brain injury: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13250868.creator: Dandan Lv, Hongyan Liu, Jing Zhao, Yang Liu, Qianqian Li, Xing’na Zhao, Liugen Wang, Xi Zeng, Yu Ding
pmc-13250868.description: BackgroundThis study reports the clinical effects of intermittent oro-esophageal tube feeding (IOE) versus nasogastric tube feeding (NGT) on nutritional status, aspiration pneumonia, decannulation, and level of consciousness in tracheostomized patients with severe traumatic brain injury (sTBI).MethodsA randomized controlled trial was conducted between March 2024 and October 2025 in China and included tracheostomized patients with sTBI.
